t1_trivial.prompt: Using the health surveillance data available to you, tell me exactly how many measles cases were reported in region R012 during the 7-day period from 2026-04-18 through 2026-04-24 (inclusive). Report a single integer.

t2_rate_rank.prompt: Using the health surveillance data, rank the top 5 regions by flu hospitalization rate per 100,000 population over the last 30 days (2026-03-26 through 2026-04-24 inclusive). For each region, report its ID, its rate per 100k (to 2 decimals), total admissions, and population. Order by rate, highest first.

t3_stats.prompt: Using the health surveillance data, compute across all countries whose total population exceeds 5,000,000: for each qualifying country, the Q1 2026 COVID-19 case-fatality ratio (CFR = total_deaths / total_cases, using records from 2026-01-01 through 2026-03-31). Then report the mean and sample standard deviation of those per-country CFRs, to 6 decimal places. Report the mean and standard deviation as numbers.

t4_outbreak.prompt: Using the surveillance dataset and any documentation available to you about how our organization defines the term, produce the canonical list of (region, disease) pairs that currently qualify as flagged under our internal outbreak-protocol reporting standard. Apply the exact documented rule — do not invent a threshold or pick a generic definition. Output in the format the protocol requires, sorted per its instructions.
